scope: Continuum constitutive formulations for soils, granular media, intact/jointed rock and interfaces, including damage, creep, unsaturated/coupled and nonlocal theories. Survey scope is broader than the executable benchmark.

units.discovery_occurrence: One returned record from one request or source location; repeats are retained.
units.publication: A bibliographic work, deduplicated separately from constitutive identities.
units.formulation: A source-specific set of governing assumptions, equations and state evolution; count only after exact variant and lineage review.
units.implementation: A numerical realization of a formulation; discretization changes do not automatically add formulations.
units.parameter_set: A material calibration or initialization set; does not add a formulation.

bibliographic_pilot.coverage: One page per theme is a bounded search-method pilot, not exhaustive retrieval. Do not report API total-results as screened records or model counts. Full search depth and supplementary routes remain to be completed before survey claims.

supplementary_routes: Source-pinned atlas candidates, including unresolved family/version records; do not count all candidates as formulations.
Foundational books and reviews, author publication lists, and material-model directories/registries; preserve route and access date.
Backward citation tracing from exact formulation sources and forward citation tracing for corrections and extensions; log each source and stopping rule.

requirements: Record publication identifier, stage, decision, reason, exact evidence locator, access level, reviewer identity/date, unresolved questions and proposed formulation IDs where justified.
Do not exclude a formulation from the survey merely because the current engine cannot express it, its code is unavailable, its calibration is expensive, or it falls outside the sand benchmark.
A complete law needs its relevant stress/kinematic relation and state/history evolution or explicit absence of history; a standalone failure criterion is a separate criterion record.
Reviews, applications, parameter recalibrations, numerical algorithms and errata remain linked evidence; they are not automatically new formulations.
An inaccessible or ambiguous source remains unresolved, not evidence of absent mechanisms. Abstract-only review cannot establish an exact full equation set.
Assisted screening remains labelled as such. Independent equation review and benchmark admission are separate gates, never inferred from discovery or passing software checks.

deduplication.doi: Normalize resolver prefixes, URL escaping when supplied as a resolver URL, case and whitespace; preserve DOI suffix punctuation. Retain all source occurrences and flag conflicting metadata.
deduplication.no_doi: Exact normalized title, full supplied author sequence and bibliographic year yield a possible-duplicate group only. Incomplete metadata stays occurrence-specific. Do not silently merge preprints, translations, corrections or near titles.
deduplication.formulations: Review governing equations, assumptions, persistent states, documented corrections and lineage separately; never equate publication count with formulation count.

known_limits: English-language queries and Crossref indexing create coverage bias; language and access gaps must be reported.

The old two Crossref cursor batches in catalogue/discovery contain predominantly biomedical titles despite geomechanics query labels. Preserve them as search-quality evidence; do not treat their labels or raw counts as useful field coverage.
No survey population frequencies, completeness claim, independently reviewed screening count or 50-formulation coverage follows from this development protocol.
